	{

		int l = sc.nextInt() - 1;
		int r = sc.nextInt();

		int shift = l / mod * mod;
		l -= shift;
		r -= shift;

		if (r > mod * 3)

		}

		for (int i = 0; i < r; i++)

			seq[i] = i;

		generate(seq, a + b, a, b);
		answer = Math.min(answer, uniqueCount(seq, l, r));

		output.append(answer);
		eOP();

				HashSet<Integer> used = new HashSet<Integer>();
